title: Artisan
wikitext: Compact window for your professions. == How to Install == # Visit the GitHub link you find, then click the green '''<> Code''' button, and select Download ZIP. # Use [https://www.7-zip.org/ 7zip] to extract the zip into your TWow/Interface/AddOns # Rename the Artisan-main folder to Artisan # Restart the game == Git Links == [https://github.com/Otari98/Artisan '''(Otari98)'''] == Commands == * '''/artisan''' - prints version and commands * '''/artisan auto''' - auto confirmation of enchant replacements (ON) * '''/artisan icons''' - icons next to skill names (ON) == Features == * Search * Convenient side tabs for all your professions * Custom categories * Key-binds for create buttons * Auto accept "replace enchant" dialogs * Shift-click to post required reagents in chat == Preview == [[File:As1.png|frameless|344x344px]] [[Category:Addon]]
